Maintainer.Profile: I build self-hosting tools for the *arr ecosystem. torbox-client lets you use TorBox as a download client for Sonarr and Radarr by emulating qBittorrent, the same way rdt-client does for Real-Debrid. media-box is an all-in-one series and movie PVR — a self-hosted Sonarr + Radarr + request-management replacement with a built-in player.
